name: Corporate Casuals
old_description: The climbers, skiers, and backcountry wanderers at Marmot surprise people each day since 1971.
about:
Corporate Casuals operates from Concord, Massachusetts, where it has been decorating apparel since 1980. The company began as an embroidery studio and, after four years, replaced its original equipment with the production facility it runs today. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom embroidery and printing on a wide range of garments and accessories—polo shirts, jackets, fleece, hats, bags, and scrubs—using state-of-the-art embroidery machines and digital printing technology. With a staff of about 15, the facility has decorated well over eight million items to date and is set up for on-demand, single-unit production with no minimum order requirements.

Customers include small businesses, corporate teams, non-profits, healthcare providers ordering scrubs and lab coats, and sports organizations needing activewear. Corporate Casuals sources blank apparel from national warehouses and decorates premium brands such as The North Face, Carhartt, Nike, Under Armour, Marmot, and New Era.

The company emphasizes personal service from industry professionals, free setup on studio designs, and what it describes as the fastest standard processing time in the industry. Its model was built to make single-unit orders profitable, allowing clients to order exactly what they need without inventory risk.
